properties.entry: INSERT INTO attendance_tbl (member_id, attend_date, check_in, check_out, status, memo) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

SELECT a.status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM attendance_tbl a JOIN class_day_tbl c ON c.class_date = a.attend_date WHERE a.member_id = ? AND a.attend_date BETWEEN ? AND ? AND c.is_class_day = TRUE GROUP BY a.status
